committedCopy: 6 of 22 shots removed before committing this report: the local overlay routes inventory-wc-elevated, owner-elevated are matched to the owner's own photographs and name a viewpoint. The full report stays in scratch. ||| SIXTH PASS, 2026-09-20 -- RE-MEASURED, NOT RE-SHOT. The two Capitol poses' `wall` and `dome` rectangles were on MapLibre's own fill-extrusions, not on anything we author: `--break slopes` deleted 3,560,273 triangles and every measured number at both poses came back bit-identical. wall and dome are now read off the A-vs-B mask of that run (92-96% of each rectangle is pixels the sabotage changed by more than 3 of 255 on any channel; 86-91% at a threshold of 6), the old rectangles are kept as `downtown`/`flanking` and declared `basemap`, and every kept report was re-measured from its OWN frames with --from against the corrected night-routes.json. No frame in this file was taken again; the frames are byte-for-byte the ones the shoot produced. Capitol numbers before and after are tabulated in docs/night-implementation-plan.md sec W0a. Every shot also gained `frame.bytes`/`frame.sha1`, and `report.exit` now exists in all ten files.
